name: letapis
description: Ask your codebase and notes by meaning, not by string. Who calls a symbol, with file and line. What was decided before, and what it led to. What is inside a book or an unfamiliar repo. Git worktrees are first-class: a branch checkout answers the one working in it. Needs a letapis engine.

plugins.name: letapis
plugins.description: Meaning-first search over your code and notes, callers of a symbol, memory of what was decided, and a graph over long documents.
